subject: Q4 GTM surge: request for offer-flex policy & contingency seats
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 GTM surge: request for offer-flex policy & contingency seats

Team —

We have three inbound opportunities (pipeline notes attached in the sheet) that, if converted on the timelines below, require us to accelerate hiring for AE and SE roles in Q4. I’m proposing we approve a temporary "offer-flex" policy (short, front-loaded OTE premium for the first 6 months) and allocate two contingency seats to avoid losing momentum on these strategic deals. High level ask:

- Open 6 priority GTM seats now (4 AE, 2 SE) + 2 contingency seats to be used within 90 days.
- Approve offer-flex: up to +15% OTE on first 6 months or increased sign-on credit (details in attached).
- Quick decision window: need budget & HR band guidance by EOD Wed so recruiting can mobilize.

Background and rationale are in the attached Q4-GTM-seat-plan.xlsx (summary on tab 1). These roles are tied to three named opportunities (pipeline IDs included) that materially change our go-to-market capacity if we win quickly. If we delay approvals we risk losing pipeline timelines and deal coverage.

Please confirm: (1) Finance support for the temporary OTE uplift, (2) People sign-off for short-term offer-flex, and (3) Sales ops prioritization so we can shift a couple of recruiters onto these reqs.

Attachments: Q4-GTM-seat-plan.xlsx, offer-bands-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 GTM surge: request for offer-flex policy & contingency seats

Thanks Grace — useful framing. Quick thoughts:

- Prioritization: please confirm the preferred order of hires (I suggest AE (2) for Opportunity A, SE (1) paired to AE on Opportunity B, then AE (2) for Opportunity C).
- Contingency seats: support the 2 seats but want a 30/60/90-day activation cadence (i.e., contingency expires if not used within 90 days).
- Geo note: keep hires in US for now; we can discuss EMEA later but these deals are US-centric.

Can Marissa confirm whether the offer-flex requires a formal comp committee escalation, or if PeopleOps can route under the rapid hire policy? If we can keep the approval one level (Head of People) it will be much faster.

If Finance can provide a provisional budget code I’ll lock in the reqs in our planning spreadsheet and hand to Recruiting to post.

Jonas
VP, Sales

Team —

Finance perspective: we can support a short-term offer-flex and two contingency seats under the following conditions:

1) Provide ROI justification per opportunity (expected incremental revenue within 6 months, attach deal IDs).
2) Contingency seats must be zero-net headcount in next quarter unless approved in next budget cycle — i.e., we expect rebalancing if deals do not convert.
3) We will allocate a provisional charge code (CC-GTM-Q4-27) but require a follow-up with actual spend in the weekly finance sync.

Anne (cc) — happy to discuss the deal attachment you flagged for scope.
